    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tracking" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Online</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Phone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OrderMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTracking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_DeliveryConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Phone" name="Phone order placed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PhoneToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderMerge" name="Order merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnlineToMerge</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateToSend</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateToSend</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendToPick</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LabelToHandOver</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOver" name="Hand over order to logistics provider">

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information to customer">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeliveredToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>

    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Delivered" name="Order delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeliveredToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_FeedbackReturn" name="Handle feedback or return" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Feedback or return received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToProcess</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FeedbackOrReturn" messageRef="Message_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessFeedback" name="Process feedback or return">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToProcess</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcessToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackHandled" name="Feedback or return handled">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcessToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>

    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneToMerge" sourceRef="StartEvent_Phone" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToConfirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderMerge" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateToSend" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendToPick" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickPack"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveredToEnd" sourceRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmed" targetRef="End_Delivered"/>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandOverToTracking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HandOverToTracking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrackingToMonitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment until it reaches customer address">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrackingToMonitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MonitorToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Delivered" name="Order delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MonitorToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_FeedbackReturn" name="Handle customer feedback or return" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Feedback or return received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToProcess</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FeedbackOrReturn" messageRef="Message_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessFeedback" name="Process feedback or return">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToProcess</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcessToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackHandled" name="Feedback or return handled">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcessToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToProcess" sourceRef="StartEvent_FeedbackOrReturn" targetRef="Task_ProcessFeedback"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcessToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ProcessFeedback" targetRef="End_FeedbackHandled"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceivedToConfirmation" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationToSend" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendToPick" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickToLabel" sourceRef="Task_PickPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToHandOver" sourceRef="Task_GenerateLabel" targetRef="Task_HandOver"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandOverToTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandOver" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrackingToMonitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToEnd" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="End_Delivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Order" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Delivered" name="Delivery to customer address confirmed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Customer feedback or return received"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Order">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Online Retailer" processRef="Process_Order"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Logistics" name="Logistics Provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OnlineOrder" name="Online order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrderOnline" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrderPhone" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Handover" name="Order handed over" sourceRef="Task_HandOver" targetRef="Participant_Logistics"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tracking" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Delivery confirmed" sourceRef="Participant_Logistics" targetRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Feedback or return" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer Order Placement" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CustomerOrder" name="Customer places order">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CustomerStartToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" name="Order channel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CustomerStartToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToOnline</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToPhone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrderOnline" name="Place order through online platform">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToOnline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OnlineToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PlaceOrderPhone" name="Place order over the phone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToPhone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PhoneToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" name="Order channel merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnlineToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PhoneToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToCustomerEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToCustomerEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerStartToSplit" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToOnline" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrderOnline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToPhone" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrderPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineToMerge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrderOnline" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneToMerge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrderPhone" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToCustomerEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" targetRef="End_OrderPlaced"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Order" name="Order Fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Company">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_OrderSystem" name="Order System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_OrderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTracking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MonitorShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_DeliveryConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_FeedbackReturn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse" name="Warehouse Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PickPack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandOver</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceivedToConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderPlaced" messageRef="Message_OrderPlaced"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceivedToConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConfirmationToSend</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConfirmationToSend</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendToPick</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PickPack" name="Pick and pack items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendToPick</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PickToLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateLabel" name="Generate shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PickToLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LabelToHandOver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOver" name="Hand over order to logistics provider">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LabelToHandOver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandOverToTracking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HandOverToTracking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrackingToMonitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment until it reaches customer address">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrackingToMonitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MonitorToDelivered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Delivered to customer address">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MonitorToDelivered</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeliveredToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Delivered" messageRef="Message_Delivered"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Delivered" name="Order delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeliveredToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_FeedbackReturn" name="Handle feedback or return" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Customer feedback or return received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToProcess</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FeedbackOrReturn" messageRef="Message_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessFeedback" name="Process feedback or return">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToProcess</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcessToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackHandled" name="Feedback or return handled">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcessToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToProcess" sourceRef="StartEvent_FeedbackOrReturn" targetRef="Task_ProcessFeedback"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcessToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ProcessFeedback" targetRef="End_FeedbackHandled"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceivedToConfirmation" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationToSend" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendToPick" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickToLabel" sourceRef="Task_PickPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToHandOver" sourceRef="Task_GenerateLabel" targetRef="Task_HandOver"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandOverToTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandOver" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrackingToMonitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToDelivered" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveredToEnd" sourceRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmed" targetRef="End_Delivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says several activities are performed independently of each other and all of them must be completed before a later step can begin: Model a parallel gateway that splits the flow into one branch per independent activity, and a parallel gateway that joins those branches so the later step starts only after all of them finish. Do not leave the branches unsynchronized, and do not use an exclusive gateway for a join that requires every branch.
rules.situation: the description says several activities are performed independently of each other and all of them must be completed before a later step can begin

rules.instruction: When the description names two or more alternative ways to carry out the same step, joined by 'or' (for example, the step may be done by one of several named means), and the model would otherwise keep only one of them: Place an exclusive gateway before the alternatives. Give each named alternative its own task on a separate outgoing sequence flow from that gateway, using the action the description names for it. Merge the alternative branches with an exclusive gateway before the next described step. Do not drop any named alternative and do not leave the choice as one unconditional flow.
rules.situation: the description says the process begins when one actor performs a start action through one of several alternative channels or means joined by 'or', where the channels are alternative ways of performing the same starting action rather than distinct triggers

rules.instruction: When the description says the process begins with a party's action that can be carried out in one of several alternative ways joined by 'or', and each alternative is work the party performs: Model one start event for the process. Follow it with an exclusive gateway that splits into one task per alternative way, each task performed by that party and named after the action the description gives for that way. Merge those branches with an exclusive gateway before the next described step. Do not model any alternative way as its own start event, and do not drop an alternative.
rules.situation: the description says the process begins with a party's action that can be carried out in one of several alternative ways joined by 'or', and each alternative is work the party performs

rules.instruction: When the description says a work activity is performed until a stated end state or location is reached, and the phrase after 'until' qualifies what the activity does: Keep the qualifying end condition (the phrase introduced by 'until' or an equivalent) in the task label, together with the action verb and its object, so the label says both what work is done and when it stops. Do not shorten the label to a bare verb-object pair when the description attaches that end condition to the activity.
rules.situation: the description says a work activity is performed until a stated end state or location is reached, and the phrase after 'until' qualifies what the activity does

rules.instruction: When the description says a process begins when an actor performs one triggering action through one of several alternative channels, so the channels are alternative ways of performing the same trigger rather than separate triggers: Model one start event for the shared trigger. Model each alternative channel as a task performed by the actor. Place an exclusive gateway after the start event to split into these channel tasks, and an exclusive merge gateway that rejoins them before the next activity. Do not create a separate start event for each channel.
rules.situation: the description says a process begins when an actor performs one triggering action through one of several alternative channels, so the channels are alternative ways of performing the same trigger rather than separate triggers
